answer: Every claim climbs the signal of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the wander re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the willow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
